name: servium
description: ServiumAI — monorepo (API NestJS + SPA React + tipos compartilhados)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @servium/shared-types && npm run build -w @servium/api && npm run build -w @servium/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @servium/shared-types && npm run test -w @servium/api && npm run test -w @servium/web
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
